text: Stayed for a night after it snowed to do a hike the next morning. The place was very cozy and in a great location that felt very homey, and with a great view of the surrounding mountains :) Would recommend!

fantastic place and location! From the moment I arrived to the time I left I felt very much at home.  The home was surprisingly quiet for the four nights that I was there--I hardly heard a peep from the owners upstairs. Super comfortable bed, I slept better there than I have in any other Airbnb.

Had a great time here. House was spotless, more spacious than the pictures portray, free of clutter, and the place looked like new. Liz was very friendly and helpful. They had set up the air mattress and put sheets etc on it, so we didn't have to worry about it. Beautiful views. Highly recommend.

Liz's place was fabulous. It is very easy to find and the check in / check out was an easy process. The space was exactly as seen in the pictures, and such a warm space! I would absolutely recommend it. It is very close to the main street (Front St) in Leavenworth, as well!

Liz’s place was so gorgeous, so clean and super cozy! She went above and beyond to set up an air mattress for my 5 year old and a pack n’ play for my 7 month old before we arrived. My little one ended up getting sick and we needed to leave really early in the morning to bring him to the doctor and Liz was completely kind, empathetic and understanding. 10/10! Thank you again for everything! 💕

Liz was extremely helpful we had a great time at her place we just had to trust the provided instructions to get to the entrance and we were all good. Area flow was great bathroom was spotless, bedroom was clean and carpets were clean. No issues with heating or water, provided plates and utensils were clean.

This place was lovely, very clean, and spacious. All of the furnishings and linens were very good quality and new looking. The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was impeccably clean with lots of space, great lighting, and toiletries. The little coffee station was stocked and the mini-fridge was handy so we could keep some helathy food, snacks, and drinks so we didnt have to eat out for every meal. Liz was helpful and welcoming in her communication. It is located conveniently close to the main part of Leavenworth, while being far enough away from the action for a peaceful retreat. We would definately stay there again during another visit to the little Bavarian town.

This place was so great!! Close enough to town to be really convenient but not so close to be in the crowds. Liz was amazing! She got ahold of me ahead of time to let me know there was a problem, worked hard to fix it, and even made us banana bread!! We loved our stay!

Everything was great. We have visited Leavenworth perhaps 10 times already and this rental was a favorite. It is out of the way of the hustle and bustle of town just by 1 mile, and it is in a quiet, safe residential area. The house itself is a main house with a few rentals that are a part of the home. Our rental was downstairs. The unit was homey and had some nice high end touches (even the toaster and the tea pot were lovely), the turkish waffle towels dry you off quickly, the snacks were yummy and appreciated, and the TV was super cool for night time chilling out. The view from the house is really incredible. We slept well in a comfortable bed. Liz was very speedy and kind in her communication. We would love to come back and know that we have found a great place to stay after all of these years of searching for just the right spot.
This is a gem in Leavenworth. Away from the busy town, but close enough! Nice Mountain View’s. Roomy and comfy. Nespresso included for a European feel!

Absolutely Perfect Stay in Leavenworth!This apartment was beyond wonderful — spotless, beautifully maintained, and filled with the most gorgeous natural light. Waking up to the sunrise right from bed was magical — the way the morning light poured in made it feel like a cozy mountain retreat straight out of a postcard.Everything was so clean and thoughtfully arranged, from the sparkling kitchenette to the fresh linens. The location was peaceful yet close to town, and the atmosphere felt both relaxing and elevated.We couldn’t have asked for a better home base for our Leavenworth getaway. Highly recommend to anyone looking for comfort, style, and those unforgettable Cascade sunrises!

Liz’s place was well beyond what we expected! Not only did she pop up an air mattress for the kids, but she left out a plate of fresh veggies and the most delicious banana bread that just made it feel so intimate and inviting for our family. We will certainly be staying here again next time we’re in town, and not just for the banana bread 😉

We arrived after midnight and Liz graciously left the unit unlocked so that we didn’t struggle with gaining entry. Though our stay was extremely short, Liz was very communicative, and the space was clean, cozy, and we enjoyed the bed linens. She thoughtfully left snacks in the fridge as well. Would recommend this spot!

Liz’s suite was the perfect home base after a long day hiking through the Enchantments. Spacious, cozy, and impeccably clean, it offered everything we needed to rest and recharge. The space was easy to find, and we really appreciated the thoughtful touches—snacks, fresh coffee, and filtered water, which made our early morning start.
Incredibly clean, homey, comfortable, communicative host, would come again
The place was nice and clean, and bigger than I expected. It was close to Leavenworth so super easy to get around.
Great stay at Liz’s place.  Host was super responsive and helpful.  The unit was exactly as described.  It was spotlessly clean.  We would stay again.

The best stay! From the location, the space, the extra touches everything was perfect. We had our 16 month old daughter with us and Liz added some toys and things for her. All the snacks and homemade treats for us! Would stay again.

Loved staying here! It was a beautiful basement apartment with a lot of space and nice big bathroom. The breakfast provided was delicious, with lots of options and added touches.  Liz was very quick to respond and gave me great recommendations when I told her our plans. It was a little bit noisy because of people living upstairs, but the owner is open and upfront about it in the listing, so nothing I wasn’t expecting. It was a great price and a great place to stay!

Liz’s place was absolutely perfect for me and two friends in town to hike the Enchantments. It was spacious, clean and had lots of natural light. We all thought the bedroom was especially peaceful, and even the air mattress was exceedingly comfortable! It wasn’t a problem to not have a full kitchenette - the kitchen appliances/items provided were thoughtful and functional. Also, Liz recommended some nearby bouldering spots to us and let us use their crash pads. Would love to stay here again!

This is a great spot at a great rate for a quick overnight. In some trees & close to town. The Nespresso machine was a wonderful perk... bring your own cream and sweetner. This is in the basement of the main house and noise from above should be expected. Don't let the conversations, walking, & children crying at 2 AM deter you from the great price and mountain views. They kindly provide earplugs and a white noise machine as well. Kitchenette with water pot was nice to have.

My friend and I had the best experience staying at Liz’s place! Everything about the space is thoughtfully designed. The bed was very comfy. The space was squeaky clean. The breakfast nook had all the things we could need. We loved the Nespresso coffee in the mornings! The spacious bathroom was amazing too. The location is great of course being so close to town and beautiful hikes. I have stayed in a hotel in Leavenworth before, but I would choose Liz’s place over a hotel because of how private, clean, and beautiful the views are. 10/10 would stay again!Lee

What a wonderful experience for our small family. The bedroom was big enough for all of us to sleep with an additional blow up bed and a pack n play, which was provided/could have been provided. The small snacks provided was pleasant as well.

We had a great time in this peaceful and beautiful apartment! It feels so quiet and relaxing while still being super close to the walkable part of downtown Leavenworth. It was perfect for our weekend stay.

What a wonderful stay.  So quiet & peaceful.  Room darkening shades in bedroom too.  Cozy & Fresh.  Thank you Liz!!!  Place was welcoming to come to after a full afternoon of strolling town.  Instant hot shower, a fam movie and it was time for a good nights rest.  Thank you again.
Liz was super sweet and accommodating.   We hope to stay again!
We have an amazing stay. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a cozy and clean place to stay!

Beautifully clean, stunning views, plenty of space for four (1 adult and three teenagers).  We used the air mattress (which the kids said was super comfy).  We appreciated the light snacks that were in the kitchenette.  Bathroom was airy and spotless.  Sheets were soft and fresh.  Bed was on the softer side (memory foam?) (just an observation, not a complaint).  Shades provided nice black-out at night.  Nice fresh ac was already on when we arrived and so appreciated on the hot summer day.  Liz is super responsive and gave me some recommendations to find a few items I needed for our visit.  Little touches like to-go cups for coffee and device chargers were super handy.  Would totally stay here again.  10/10!

A hidden gem in Leavenworth, just minutes from downtown but far enough to feel secluded and private. We had a relaxing weekend at Liz’s and hope to be back again soon, this was the perfect location for us and couldn’t recommend it enough if you’re planning a visit to Leavenworth.
Such a lovely and spotless place, and absolutely incredible host—super kind, responsive, and thoughtful! The four of us felt right at home at Liz’s!
We had a wonderful stay! We felt right at home with the comfortable bed, homemade bread, snacks and coffee provided! We are so grateful!
This was the perfect spot for us as we made a stop in our road trip. It’s clean and cozy, just what we were looking for!

Lovely stay! Kind host, attentive! The space was clean and exactly as described, which was reassuring and comfortable to me. We were a family, so the family sounds upstairs did not bother us at all, we appreciated their grace with our kids as well. This stay is great with kids! We utilized the inflatable bed - it was surprisingly very comfortable! My only downside was the value- the stay has no amenities and most all other places we considered for a trip have amenities/kitchens/etc for the same price. For only a little more, many places have access to hot tubs, pools, and other amenities. They also accommodated a very last minute booking, which I appreciated. Overall, thankful for clean sheets, a clean new feel to the home, and everything going as we expected and hoped!
Really liked the place! It was clean and the view was beautiful. The space was bigger than we were expecting which was wonderful.
Loved our stay here. Very clean & comfy, beautiful mountain views and just a short drive to downtown
Perfect stay for us prior to heading out on a trail head early in the morning. Clean, comfy bed, great snack + coffee bar. Will be back if in Leavenworth again!
Very awesome!AlexandraCoeur d'Alene, Idaho
Cute little place to stay and close to some trails and Leavenworth!
Very clean, excellent location, and great communication from host!
We loved how close the place was to downtown! Nice and clean and very comfortable!
This is a gem in Leavenworth. Close to town and perfect for us and our infant!
We wish we could have stayed here longer! The apartment was beautiful and easily one of the nicest rentals we have ever stayed at.
Great place for the night!Margot7 years on AirbnbRating, 5 stars,  · July 2025A delightful place to stay, very peaceful and comfortable
Liz was great at communicating and accommodating our needs.
Great place!

A great little studio for two. Clean, well-equipped, and easy to access. Only a quick drive to downtown, too. The mountain views from the porch are great - perfect for morning coffee. The simple breakfast items were a nice bonus, not many hosts provide that. The space does share a wall with the host's home, but we never heard a sound the entire stay. Would definitely recommend.

It was a wonderfully peaceful place, truly a home away from home. I had hoped to stay longer, as I thoroughly enjoyed my four days there, but unfortunately, I had to return home. I particularly appreciated the opportunity to walk to the nearby town, indulge in hiking, and admire the starry night sky and the moon, experiences I rarely get to appreciate in the city.

Liz’s place was exactly as described and seen in pictures. Bed was so so comfortable, I even asked her where she got the mattress and bedding. I’m an Airbnb host as well, and I give Liz 5 stars! Place had nice,  little details giving it a home away from home feel. Phone charger, white noise speaker, facial masks, kitchen stocked with most things, and a cute little oatmeal breakfast bar. Liz was quick to respond as well. Definitely recommend.
This was a great spot! Surroundings were so beautiful and it was so close to lots to do in downtown Leavenworth. Liz was very responsive and such a great host with some great recommendations.

Cute place to stay in a neighborhood near downtown. It's possible to walk to town in about 20-25 minutes! The view out the room and from the patio is so beautiful. There's a stove, microwave, and refrigerator to make longer stays comfortable.

We loved staying at Liz’s for the weekend. The view of the mountains is incredible and the place itself was thoughtfully decorated and clean. It was also very close to downtown shops and restaurants, only a few minutes drive.
A perfect home away from home! The space was clean, inviting, and the bed was exceptionally comfortable. I felt right at home immediately. I would definitely stay here again!

A quiet, cozy and clean space to enjoy mountain views and relax. No TV to disctract, just trees and nature. Perfect space for 2 and excusrions into Leavenworth or day hikes. Host was communicative and responsive.

Beautiful location, minimalist hygge kinda vibe, with many details we really appreciated - dimming lights on all switches, natural bed linens, very comfortable bed, candles, palo santo, sleep sound machine.  We were so stoked to be in such a cozy, clean, well thought out, comfy place with stunning mountain-views, and especially at such a good price point. Def would stay here again.

10/10 experience, with an extremely intentional and thoughtful space, felt extremely cozy. Liz was extremely kind and even left my pregnant wife a pregnancy pillow which was so sweet and convenient after a long trip. Balcony views were stunning, and it was just about 4-5 minutes from downtown Leavenworth. Would highly recommend! Thank you so much Liz!

Cute little place to stay in Leavenworth when I attended Oktoberfest! Liz was very friendly and easily reachable when I messaged her. Would definitely stay here again in the future. Bed was comfortable and the place was spacious and very clean. I was very impressed with the 3 in 1 charger for apple iphone/watch/airpod. I didn’t even reach into my duffle to grab my cables.

Liz’s place was perfect for our one night weekend stay in Leavenworth! Liz was accommodating, helpful, and friendly during the check-in process. The studio had everything we needed, great views, and was extremely clean. Would highly recommend and stay again if in the area!

Liz was an outstanding host!! As an Airbnb owner myself, I have high expectations and Liz and her home met all of them. The room was spacious enough for 2, had the amenities we needed and had a beautiful view. I highly recommend booking her place as it was close to downtown and beautiful

We had such a lovely stay at Liz’s place. Her home was so comfortable and cozy and not far from town! The views from the balcony were just stunning and lovely to wake up too! She was kind enough to leave us some homemade zucchini bread which was amazing!!! Would definitely stay again!
Clean and as described, close to downtown and you can walk if you’d like. Beautiful views off the balcony.
Liz‘s place was a great place to stay. It’s safe. The bed is comfortable. Everything is very clean and has beautiful surroundings.

unfortunately due to extreme weather we couldn't do any of the things we wanted to do in the area, and the power was out. we ended up leaving early but the hosts were very accommodating and understanding of the situation offering us lights when we got there and very kind overall

Liz and her space was lovely! We booked more time than we needed to ensure we got a weather window for an Enchantments traverse. The weather turned out to be beautiful the whole time we were there allowing for more exploring. Much to do in Leavenworth, but we appreciated being able to relax in a cozy beautiful place. Watching sunset from the deck with a glass of wine was a favorite nightly activity.

Thank you Liz  for hosting us! We had an amazing time at your place ! It was a little piece of heaven :) very comfy, very clean , super cute furnitures and comfy bed and linens , everything was earthy and organic , we loved it so much ! The coffee was awesome and all the little snacks especially the sunflower seeds …. The best :) Liz was super responsive and very attentive to our needs . Thanks again ! We will be back hopefully soon !

Loved this location- close enough to downtown to easily experience the adorable atmosphere of Leavenworth, but far enough away that we didn’t have to deal with the noise of the crowds. Liz was proactive in communicating with me, kind and the listing was exactly as described. 10/10 host and 10/10 property. I loved her attention to detail in the bedside wireless charger, sound machine and comfortable linens. Thank you, Liz! 💟

Liz’s place was perfect!! It was so peaceful inside and a beautiful view outside. It’s close to downtown which was really nice when we wanted to go out for dinner or to go shopping. Liz gave some awesome recommendations for us, definitely go down to the river!! No thermostat in the room, as stated, but Liz was quick to reply and change the air when we needed it done. Would definitely stay here again!!

Good stay in Leavenworth. We shared the queen bed with our three-year-old, and it was comfortable. A really clean space with a nice balcony to relax and take in the view. Great to offer some snacks in the kitchen and pretty much all the equipment you would need to cook a small meal. A very short drive from the main/business streets and happenings in town.

The location was very easy to find, the self check in was quite easy as well, the view from the balcony was amazing, very clean bathroom( always a plus),  all the kitchen utensils were accessible,  it’s a 4 minute drive from the main town, me and my fiancé had a blast. Amazing host overall, will book in the future again.:)Response from LizJune 2025Glad it was a wonderful stay!
We really enjoyed our stay at Liz's suite. She was very responsive and check in was easy. We would have stayed another night but it was booked!
Very nice unit.  Clean, well laid out, nicely furnished.  Really enjoyed our stay.
The views from the studio are beautiful and it’s a short 20 minute walk into Leavenworth town centre.
Great place close to downtown Leavenworth. Clean with a nice view.
Liz was a great host! Super responsive to all our asks, and great instructions to check in, charge our car, and check out!
Clean, private, quiet space! We didn’t want to stay in a hotel close to town due to noise and Liz’s place was perfect. Would stay again.
The place was very clean and a beautiful view. Worked great for our short visit! The host provided everything needed and was really responsive!
Beautiful space, beautiful location, comfortable bed, extremely clean, organic, and natural products & linens. Wish I could stay longer! Thank you, Liz!

We absolutely LOVED our stay! Liz was friendly, helpful, and responsive in all our messages! Everything was straightforward and simple to find. The place was immaculately clean, yet didn’t smell or feel like a hotel. There are so many little, thoughtful details throughout (ex: earplugs, makeup removing wipes, basic and easy breakfast items) yet it doesn’t feel cluttered. It’s a beautiful place, with a great view, and even a private porch! I would highly recommend Liz’s place to anyone!

Beautiful space!  Special touches with pottery, fresh flowers from her garden and even homemade zucchini bread she made for our stay. Kitchen has everything you would need down to the nice little oatmeal fixings.  Thoughtfully put together with a beautiful view! Would absolutely stay here again.

The place is cute and cozy. It was super clean and neatly organized, and you can tell the owner really cares about maintaining it. The location is also great—just 5–10 minutes from tourists area. We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you!

This is a wonderful place to stay! The bed is large and comfortable, the bathroom is well stocked, and kitchenette has everything needed for a short stay; it even has some pots and pans with a hot plate to cook. Liz is a wonderful host who is a great communicator. Some Airbnb hosts will go with lower end supplies, or finishes in the property but not here! You can tell that she has put great care and thought into the space as everything is immaculate. Definitely a must stay if you are in the area.

Overall  wonderful stay, adorable studio, nice modern aesthetic and decor, balcony view. Thoughtful touches: makeup wipes, snacks, and Liz baked up homemade banana bread. Perfect size for two people. Definitely would stay here again.
Had a great stay for a stop over at Leavenworth ! AC helped tremendously during heat wave. Great location not too far from downtown, private enough and great porch view !

Liz’s place was very clean and charming. It is private and has a nice outdoor patio to sit and drink coffee at in the morning and watch the birds. It is just a short few minute drive from the main tourist part of Leavenworth. We really enjoyed our stay there and would highly recommend to anybody.

Such a cozy and inviting space! The place was clean, spacious, and had a beautiful view. Everything about it made our stay in Leavenworth relaxing and enjoyable. It was very close to downtown. I would definitely stay again!

The views 20/10!  Pictures could never capture the beauty of it. This cute little spot was also a nice walk to the town center. Just be ready to go uphill on the way home (: I will definitely be back! Prost!
This place is really peaceful and cozy. The bed was fantastic and the host was very kind! I loved the location, and you’re still less than a 10 minute drive to the main downtown area. Great stay!

A true gem! Perfect place to stay for us, a couple exploring Leavenworth for the first time. The place was new and tastefully decorated. We appreciated the fresh fruit and oatmeal for breakfast. Beautiful Mountain View from the back porch.

Awesome stay! We had no trouble accessing the studio, it was very clean and organized. Had everything we needed and the best was the views. It was very nice to be able to enjoy a cup of coffee out in the deck, listening to the birds and enjoying the views. I would definitely come back.

The pictures simply doesn’t do it justice! Liz’s place was clean and had everything I needed for a relaxing stay! Not to mention it was so beautiful and cozy! The host was very gracious and helpful! Would highly recommend, and would definitely come back!
Liz was proactive and friendly. The place has beautiful views and is cozy.
Very nice cozy place to stay at!
Great place! Clean and private with great amenities.
Best view & so peaceful! We loved waking up to the view and that we were just minutes from downtown Leavenworth attractions and the reindeer farm.
Liz's place was located in a gorgeous neighborhood overlooking the mountains. The apartment was pristine and she even made her own zucchini bread!
Can’t say enough about how accommodating Liz was. Her place was the perfect stay for our little family of 3 and what a gorgeous view!
This was a super quick trip for me, late arrival and very early start the next day. Found the home very clean and comfortable.  Thanks for letting me stay.
This place was quiet, clean and beautifully appointed. It had everything we needed and more—an amazing deck to hang out on and enjoy Leavenworth’s beautiful views.
Beautiful studio had all we needed for a couples getaway. It was a  little walk into town, but we enjoyed the privacy. Would definitely stay here again.
Beautiful studio- absolutely pristine and new with nice views! Liz was extremely responsive and helpful. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

We sadly only got to stay two nights, but it was a lovely trip! Would stay here again. We were surprised, and honestly a little bit disappointed, to show up and realize that the unit was adjoined to the main house and with an interior door also. I'm sure that is completely on me not reading the listing fully though! And we were pleasantly surprised with how quiet it was! We were never disturbed whatsoever and never saw a soul. It was a very peaceful stay and I soaked up the view! It had everything we needed, minus shower water pressure and a means of temperature control. We got a little bit too warm at times, and the cross breeze we created wasn't quite enough to cool to the degree we would like, but we just know for next time to pick a stay no later in the months than we did. Again, would recommend and revisit. The best part about our stay was the walkability. It's about a mile and a half into town and it's a lovely walk, so we definitely took advantage of that. Thanks, Liz!Response from LizJune 2025Thanks for staying with us and for your feedback! We’ll make some adjustments to the cooling in the studio - we didn’t have the AC turned on yet for the summer (wish we had known it was a bit stuffy for you all!) - sorry for your discomfort! Should you want to come back next year, we can definitely have it turned on earlier in the season to keep things cool!Show more
Beautiful studio with comfortable furniture and wonderful view!
We loved our stay. Hope to stay longer next time. The view? Priceless!
Such an amazing spot!
Really cozy and perfect for 2. Clean and comfy suite!
Super cute place and really close to town, perfect for the two of us- thanks!!Seung Hee
Liz’s place was just perfect for a weekend getaway! Thank you Liz for having us!! (:
great view, great location. would recommend to anyone!
Great place, host, location. View from the balcony is breathtaking!
awesome place, super quiet, really peaceful and lovely! will definitely stay again
This place has beautiful views and is very clean.
